feature_intro.title: Understand any story at a glance
feature_intro.description: A summary writer for fiction: the story summarizer turns pasted prose into a fixed, scannable structure, so you can see what happens, who changes, and what the story is really about — without rereading everything.

items.title: Structured, not just shorter
items.description: Every result has the same five sections: summary, plot beats, characters, themes, and central conflict.

items.title: Keeps your language
items.description: The summary is written in the same language as the text you paste — no translation step, no switch in voice.

items.title: Premise-only mode
items.description: Choose Premise only for a spoiler-safe overview that stops before later twists and the ending.

how_to_use.title: How to write a summary of a story
how_to_use.description: From pasted text to structured summary in three steps.

items.title: Paste your text

items.title: Pick length and spoiler detail

items.title: Generate the summary

items.title: Copy or keep writing

faq_section.title: Story Summarizer FAQ
faq_section.description: How the tool works, what it does with your text, and what to expect from the results.

items.title: Is the story summarizer free?
items.description: Yes. This free AI summarizer works within a daily fair-use limit, and signing in gives you more daily summaries.

items.title: Do you store the story text I paste?
items.description: No. Your pasted text is sent to generate the summary and is not saved to your account or our database. Only anonymous usage counts are recorded.

items.title: How long can my text be?
items.description: Up to 20,000 characters per summary. For a long manuscript, split it into chapters or scenes and summarize each part.

items.title: Which language is the summary written in?
items.description: By default the summary follows the language of the text you paste: an English chapter gets an English summary, a Japanese chapter a Japanese one. You can also pick a fixed output language from the dropdown if you want the result in another language.

items.title: Are the 50, 150, and 500 word options exact?
items.description: No. They are approximate targets that steer the level of detail; the exact length varies with the story.

items.title: What does Premise only mean?
items.description: Premise only summarizes the setup and avoids revealing later twists, the ending, or final outcomes in every section. It suits blurbs and spoiler-safe sharing, though it cannot account for every reader's own spoiler sensitivity.

cta_section.title: Write a summary, then keep writing
cta_section.description: Use the summary as your notes, then open AI Write to draft the next chapter with Story Bible and Consistency Check by your side.
